blocks.text: You can change or reset your password for security reasons.

blocks.item: On the Accounts Settings page, under Change Password, enter your Current Password.
Enter your New Password, and then enter it again in the Confirm New Password field.

blocks.text: An estimator is used to determine the password strength. The color meter below New Password indicates the password strength. For example, a green line indicates a strong password and a red line indicates a weak password.
After the password is changed, you will receive a confirmation email.
